name: Vegetarian Mee Goreng
steps: Loosen the fresh eggless yellow wheat noodles, rinsing briefly if the pack recommends it, and drain well. Whisk kecap manis, light soy sauce and ketchup together. Prepare cabbage, sprouts, tomato, scallion, red chili and garlic before heating the wok.
Press tofu dry. Heat 15 ml oil in a wide wok over medium-high heat and sear the cubes on several sides for 5–6 minutes until golden. Remove to a plate.
Heat the remaining 25 ml oil. Add garlic and red chili for 20 seconds, then cabbage for 2 minutes. Add tomato wedges and stir briefly so they hold their shape.
Add noodles and prepared sweet-soy sauce. Toss over high heat for 2–3 minutes until hot, brown and lightly caramelized. Return tofu, add bean sprouts and cook 1 more minute so sprouts stay crisp.
Turn off the heat and stir through lime juice. Divide into four plates, top with spring onions and crispy fried shallots, and serve immediately while the noodles are glossy.
tips: Check noodle and fried-shallot labels for egg or seafood seasoning. The reviewed photo shows dark sweet-soy wheat noodles, tofu, cabbage, sprouts, tomato, chili, scallions, fried shallots and lime.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
